user.title: Eilwacht
user.description:
Breaking news from tagesschau.de work right away. Afterwards, add news watches for your federal state via “Add news watch”.

Source: tagesschau.de, for private use only. Eilwacht is not affiliated with ARD.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Eilwacht is already set up. Add news watches there.

user.title: Add news watch
user.description: Announces new items from the chosen federal states – optionally only those mentioning certain keywords.

data_description.name: For example “Stuttgart”. Used in entity names.
data_description.regions: Regional news of these states. “Germany-wide” adds national news without a state.
data_description.keywords: Optional, comma-separated; one of them is enough, case does not matter. A keyword finds words starting with it: “Stuttgart” also finds “Stuttgarter”, “Streik” also “Streiks”. “*streik” also finds words containing it (“Warnstreik”), “-Fußball” excludes. Empty: every item.

reconfigure.title: Change news watch
reconfigure.description:
**How this watch is set up**

{summary}
- New items trigger the event “New item” for automations (for example the push blueprint of Eilwacht) and appear in the sensors “Last item” and “Items (24 h)”.
- Breaking news come from the device “Eilwacht”, independent of this watch.

After changing federal states or keywords, the watch announces only what appears afterwards.

data_description.name: For example “Stuttgart”. Used in entity names.
data_description.regions: Regional news of these states. “Germany-wide” adds national news without a state.
data_description.keywords: Optional, comma-separated; one of them is enough, case does not matter. A keyword finds words starting with it: “Stuttgart” also finds “Stuttgarter”, “Streik” also “Streiks”. “*streik” also finds words containing it (“Warnstreik”), “-Fußball” excludes. Empty: every item.

error.no_regions: Choose at least one federal state.

options.regions_and_national: Regional news from {regions}, plus Germany-wide news
options.regions_only: Regional news from {regions}, no Germany-wide news
options.national_only: Only Germany-wide news (without a federal state)
options.keywords: Keywords: {keywords} (one is enough, case does not matter)
